newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Vencemos unit sells $20 mln Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Vencemos unit sells $20 mln Eurobonds.

text.p: Vencemos Financial Corp, a subsidiary of Venezuelan cement company Vencemos, placed Monday a $20 million issue of five-year Eurobonds, lead agent Merinvest told Reuters.
The issue carried a 8.5 percent coupon with biannual interest payments, Merinvest senior advisor Alfonso Ortega said.
The bonds, to be used to restructure short-term debt, are guaranteed by Vencemos, itself a unit of Mexican cement giant Cemex.
It was the third Eurobond issue by Vencemos in the last 13 months. In June 1996, it placed $20 million and in October a further $25 million.
